title.zh: 删除项目下用户创建的自定义应用
title.en: Delete a custom application created by a user in a project

descriptions.zh: > 根据项目id和应用id删除项目下用户创建的自定义应用，删除之后可以恢复，可以通过再创建相同包名的应用来恢复，之前应用的AppId，AppKey，AppSecret信息不变。
descriptions.en: > Deletes a custom application created by a user in a project based on the project ID and application ID. After deletion, the application can be recovered by creating a new application with the same package name. The AppId, AppKey, and AppSecret of the original application remain unchanged.
